assumptions.model: New geometry-audited 33-sphere reconstruction; asset selection fixed before benchmark outcomes, not original author assets.
assumptions.random_inputs: Original task list, seeds, obstacle dimensions and pose distribution are unpublished. Fixed environment indices0..9 are declared constructed cases, not blind held-out tasks. Obstacle RNG SeedSequence[250410783,seed] retains fixed previous scenes. Independent start/target streams [250410783,5,seed,1 or2] select first collision-free joint-uniform point in each TCP box; target is its FK (not uniform Cartesian/SO3). Each side has a strict200000 sample cap. Goal joints are solved ONLINE per roadmap; no reselection after planner/optimizer failure.
assumptions.velocity_acceleration: Unit per-joint bounds as released example/hardware section; simulation limits and Bezier degree unpublished.
assumptions.nto: Original DRM nodes initialize order-2 distance splines; order-4 time splines repeat first/last control once for standstill. No arclength resampling. Use exactly Nc collision constraints to match the formal PDF; positions k/(Nc+1), k=1,...,Nc are declared construction choices. Draft TeX uses Nc-1 internal bindings and is preserved separately in v4.
assumptions.solvers: LSCS Clarabel substitutes for unlicensed MOSEK. LGCS exact Gurobi MISOCP; restricted-license failures retained. Native wheel and solver versions postdate paper.
assumptions.budget: 60s solver limit and 240s case watchdog are reconstruction limits, not values supplied by paper.
assumptions.validation: Dense independent Drake checks with bounded step; no continuous collision certificate. Known-invalid DRM seeds are not inflated; NTO still receives them as warm starts. Native DRM success and independently valid DRM success are reported separately.
assumptions.endpoint_margin: 1e-5 m IK margin is a declared numeric implementation choice to obtain collision-free float32-representable endpoints without changing target poses; the paper does not specify its numeric margin.
assumptions.eizo_max_iterations: 30 from author arXiv TeX commented parameter blocks. Formal published Tables III/IV take precedence for all overlapping settings.
assumptions.drm: Offline native node, adjacency, pose and voxel collision maps for BOTH environments. Online goal IK is initialized by collision-free pose-map nearest nodes, per Section V-B. Native lazy step 0.1 retained. Unpublished native planner defaults are recorded.
assumptions.forest_inputs: Same fixed predeclared environment seeds and endpoints as v3; static point radius1e-6. Random endpoint coordinates and original seed list not released.
